# AiMessageResponse

```ts
import { AiMessageResponse } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The assistant's reply in an AI conversation: one or more paragraphs, then optionally where the answer came from (sources), the one action it offers (action), and a feedback row (feedback). Put attachments such as cards or plan steps directly below it in the conversation. The person's own prompt is entered with AiQueryInput.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The reply. Strings render as paragraphs; pass an array for several paragraphs, or any nodes for richer content. |
| `segment` | `AiSegment` | `'consumer'` | AI segment — tints the action button. |
| `sources` | `AiSource[]` | — | Where the answer came from, shown above the action (Figma showSources). |
| `action` | `AiMessageResponseAction` | — | The one primary action the response offers (Figma showAction). |
| `feedback` | `AiFeedbackProps` | — | Shows the feedback row at the bottom (Figma showFeedback). |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'onCopy'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<AiMessageResponse>{['First paragraph.', 'Second paragraph.']}</AiMessageResponse>
<AiMessageResponse action={{ label: 'Start deployment plan', onClick: start }}>{reply}</AiMessageResponse>
<AiMessageResponse sources={sources}>{reply}</AiMessageResponse>
<AiMessageResponse feedback={{ onValueChange: rate, onCopy: copy, onRegenerate: retry }}>{reply}</AiMessageResponse>
<AiMessageResponse segment="commercial" action={{ label: 'Open report' }}>{reply}</AiMessageResponse>
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-text-icon-primary`, `--type-size-body`, `--space-200`, `--space-300`, `--space-600`, `--color-ai-`

## Accessibility

- Renders an <article>, so each reply is a distinct unit. While a reply streams in, announce it from the conversation's aria-live log region, not from this block.
- Sources are real links; feedback buttons are named and report their state (aria-checked).
- Offer one primary action at most, labelled with what it does.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Show sources when the answer draws on documents | Present unsourced claims as facts |
| Offer one clear AI action | Stack several AI buttons |
| Add feedback where answers can be wrong | Add feedback to system messages |
